exposure: atosiban treatment for threatened preterm labor (TPL)
ritodrine treatment for threatened preterm labor (TPL)
cohort: The study included first-time mothers diagnosed with preterm labor before 34 weeks of pregnancy who delivered at one of three hospitals and received drug treatment for more than 2 days to delay delivery, with cases covering singleton and multiple pregnancies.
finding: Using atosiban for TPL is more effective than ritodrine for maintaining pregnancy in multifetal pregnancies, and it results in superior neonatal outcomes in singleton pregnancies.
gest_age: Babies included were from pregnancies diagnosed with preterm labor before 34 weeks of gestation, and gestational age at birth was an outcome component (duration/maintenance of pregnancy).
